name: merge-lane
description: One merge lane per repo across concurrent sessions: a priority queue, a Bash merge gate, auto-release on merge, and a wake-up for the next session.

auto.title: Auto-proceed when the lane frees
auto.description: When this session is woken with the lane, submit the proceed-with-merge prompt for it, as this mod's own message (never as your words). /lane auto on|off overrides it for one session.

staleMinutes.title: Stale holder after (minutes)
staleMinutes.description: A holder whose heartbeat is older than this, whose session also fails a liveness ping, may be broken with /lane take. The queue head breaks it on its own 5 minutes later.

maxHoldMinutes.title: Max hold without a merge attempt (minutes)
maxHoldMinutes.description: A holder that has made no merge attempt for this long hands the lane to the next waiting session. 0 turns this off.

enforce.title: Enforce the merge gate
enforce.description: Refuse merges (gh pr merge, merge API calls, pushes to main/master) from sessions that do not hold the lane. Off: the queue and commands still work, nothing is refused.

allowAutoMerge.title: Allow gh pr merge --auto
allowAutoMerge.description: Off by default: auto-merge bypasses the lane and the re-verify-before-merge step, so it is refused.
